L3.why: ADC1 channel 3 ("VN"). 2.2 V at 29.4 V, inside the accurate ADC range.

L4.connects: Left A3144 hall output, 10k pull-up to 3.3 V, 100 nF
L4.why: Input only, no internal pull-up, so the external one is required. To be counted with the PCNT unit.

L5.connects: Right A3144 hall output, 10k pull-up to 3.3 V, 100 nF

L11.why: Toggles during boot. Harmless: DRIVE_EN holds the drivers off until the car is armed.

L12.connects: Q1 MOSFET gate through 100 Ω, 10k pull-down
L12.why: Strapping pin: HIGH at reset selects 1.8 V flash and the board won't boot. The pull-down that keeps the contactor open also keeps the strap LOW. Never add a pull-up.

R1.connects: All I2C devices, 4.7k pull-up to 3.3 V
R1.why: The Arduino default SDA is GPIO21, which DRIVE_EN uses. Set with Wire.begin(23, 22).

R2.connects: All I2C devices, 4.7k pull-up to 3.3 V

R5.connects: R_EN + L_EN of all four drive IBT-2s, 10k pull-down
R5.why: Plain I/O, quiet at boot. The most important pin on the board, so it gets a pin with no boot role at all.

R8.why: Strapping pin that idles HIGH; a UART TX idles HIGH too. May output a short signal at boot, which the DFPlayer ignores.

R10.why: UART2's default RX. CRSF at 420000 baud.

R12.connects: R_EN + L_EN of the steering IBT-2, 10k pull-down
R12.why: Strapping pin, must be LOW to flash. The on-board LED and the pull-down both hold it LOW, and the LED lights when steering is enabled.

R13.connects: DS18B20 box temperature, 4.7k pull-up to 3.3 V
R13.why: Strapping pin that idles HIGH (boot log on); the 1-Wire pull-up agrees. Proposed by the draft schematic; was spare.

R15.why: The board's 3.3 V regulator stays for the ESP32 alone; sensors use the separate 3V3_SENSE rail.
